memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Primary hypothyroidism. The patient reports progressive fatigue, weight gain of 5 kg over 3 months, dry skin, and intolerance to cold. Examination shows mild pallor and delayed relaxation of ankle jerks. Smoking status: never smoked, pack‑years 0. Plan: start levothyroxine 50 mcg OD and check TSH in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Levothyroxine 50 mcg oral tablet, take once daily in the morning on an empty stomach. Continue until reviewed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Primary hypothyroidism, inadequately replaced. Patient still fatigued, weight unchanged, skin dry. Exam: mild pallor, relaxed ankle jerks slightly delayed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack‑years 0. TSH elevated. Plan: increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD, repeat TSH in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Levothyroxine 75 mcg oral tablet, take once daily in the morning on an empty stomach. Continue until reviewed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Primary hypothyroidism, near target. Patient reports improved energy, mild weight gain of 1 kg, no cold intolerance. Exam: normal pallor, ankle jerks prompt. Smoking status: never smoked, pack‑years 0. TSH borderline high. Plan: continue levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, repeat TSH in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Levothyroxine 75 mcg oral tablet, take once daily in the morning on an empty stomach. Continue until reviewed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Primary hypothyroidism, stable but patient reports renewed fatigue and 2 kg weight gain. Exam: mild pallor, ankle jerks slightly delayed. Smoking status: never smoked, pack‑years 0. TSH within normal range but symptoms suggest need for higher dose. Plan: increase levothyroxine to 100 mcg OD, re‑check TSH in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Levothyroxine 100 mcg oral tablet, take once daily in the morning on an empty stomach. Continue until reviewed.

memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked with Dr Suresh Menon (D05) for 2026-08-20 at 10:30 am. Please arrive 10 minutes early.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Diagnosis: Primary hypothyroidism, well controlled. Patient denies fatigue, weight stable, skin normal. Exam: no pallor, ankle jerks prompt. Smoking status: never smoked, pack‑years 0. TSH within target. Plan: continue levothyroxine 100 mcg OD, annual review unless symptoms change.
